ast10.text: Does this agent skill contain instructions or code that deliberately steal data, run unauthorized commands, exfiltrate secrets, or hide its behavior from the user?
ast10.yes: The skill has clearly malicious intent or behavior.
ast10.no: The skill's behavior matches its stated, legitimate purpose.

ast10.text: Does this skill download and execute remote code, install packages from unusual sources, or use a name or source that imitates a trusted package?
ast10.yes: The skill fetches and runs untrusted remote code or imitates a trusted source.
ast10.no: The skill has no fetch-and-run installs and no imitation of trusted packages.

ast10.text: Does this skill request or use permissions, file access, network access or shell access well beyond what its stated purpose needs?
ast10.yes: The skill asks for far more access than its purpose requires.
ast10.no: The access the skill uses is proportionate to its purpose.

ast10.text: Does the metadata or frontmatter of this skill contain injected instructions, misleading descriptions, or content designed to manipulate the agent that loads it?
ast10.yes: The metadata contains injection or manipulative content.
ast10.no: The metadata is a plain, honest description.

ast10.text: Does this skill tell the agent to fetch and follow instructions from an external URL or remote source that could change over time?
ast10.yes: The skill defers its behavior to remotely hosted instructions.
ast10.no: All instructions are contained in the skill itself.

generic-5q.text: Would installing this agent skill put the user's data or system at risk?
Does this skill try to do something harmful or deceptive?
generic-5q.yes: The skill is harmful or deceptive.
generic-5q.no: The skill is honest and harmless.

generic-5q.text: Is this skill designed to attack, spy on, or trick the user or their agent?
generic-5q.yes: The skill attacks, spies on, or tricks.
generic-5q.no: The skill does none of these.

generic-5q.text: Should a security reviewer reject this skill?
